statement: NVIDIA's NVLink Fusion is being used to pull third-party inference silicon into NVIDIA rack systems built around Vera CPUs, NVLink switches, BlueField-4 DPUs, ConnectX-9 SuperNICs and Spectrum-X Ethernet.
why: Even when the accelerator is someone else's, NVIDIA keeps the CPU, interconnect and networking content in the rack, which protects its attach rate.

impact.mechanism: Opening the interconnect to partner silicon wins rack sockets for NVIDIA's surrounding components and targets latency-sensitive workloads such as coding assistants, chatbots and voice agents.

evidence.excerpt: NVLink Fusion enables partners to integrate custom silicon with NVIDIA's deep ecosystem of NVLink, advanced packaging, rack-scale systems and networking technologies.

confidence.basis: Single vendor announcement at secondary tier; no shipment or design-win counts disclosed.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: d-matrix.ai, theregister.com
